body:
## Intent
Post-merge acceptance fixture for adoption #65 / merged PR #67, following the closed pre-merge fixture #66. Add one short sentence to tests/README.md naming the two host-only EngineTests and explaining that container verification alone cannot authorize integration. Preserve existing commands and wording otherwise.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The added sentence names both Docker engine tests and requires the separate host suite and full CI before integration.
- Preserve all commands, tests, dependencies, workflow, policy, harness, product and architecture behavior.
- Create the small required OpenSpec planning artifacts and one implementation PR; report actual checks and unmet gates accurately.
- Native refinement completion starts one independent implementation worker; implementation and same-PR feedback use the declared dotnet/PostgreSQL environment. Receipts must preserve source links, evaluation outcomes and reservation release.

## Scope
Documentation only, for the SoFa maintainer. Dependencies: #64 and #67 are merged. Accepted ADR-0006 and existing ProductShape scope remain unchanged. Security: no Docker socket inside the workload, no relaxed checks or tooling repairs. Performance and accessibility: N/A for one documentation sentence. No product or architecture decision is requested.

## Operational acceptance fixture
The owner already authorized the bounded refinement → implementation → PR, feedback and integration-control exercise in #65. This fresh fixture verifies the post-merge native path that the earlier experiment could not prove. Do not merge this PR or claim human acceptance. The coordinating operator will give feedback, inspect integration controls with merge=false and close the test PR without merging. A green workflow is not a passed assessment; reviewRequired remains true. Preserve the candidate and report blockers if any check is unavailable or fails.

## Fixture closure
PR #70 was closed without merge after a passed refinement, implementation and same-PR feedback with passing independent dotnet/PostgreSQL checks, duplicate-receipt rejection, stale-head and draft integration guards. The implementation assessments remain blocked and no human acceptance is claimed. Automatic refinement continuation was not observed before official after_run recovery; canonical lifecycle labels remained stale. The publisher could not start feedback-head CI; the operator explicitly dispatched [full verification](https://github.com/juangcarmona/sofa/actions/runs/40522957843), whose current outcome must be checked separately. Reservations were released and temporary containers/networks removed. This closes the experiment, not delivered product work. Post-merge evidence follows adoption #65.
